list.title: Members
list.subtitle: Collaboration across {{repositories}} repositories
list.empty: No members yet. Analyze a repository to see who's contributing.
list.untrack_description: Their email is added to the exclusion list, so they disappear from every members view — including repositories analyzed in the future. This is reversible: remove the exclusion under Manage exclusions to track them again.
list.untrack_disabled_anonymized: Turn off anonymization to untrack members
list.merge_disabled_anonymized: Turn off anonymization to merge members
list.sole_maintainer_hint_one: Only tracked contributor on {{count}} repository — a bus-factor risk.
list.sole_maintainer_hint_other: Only tracked contributor on {{count}} repositories — a bus-factor risk.

health.single_maintainer_hint: Repositories with only one member — a bus-factor risk.
health.concentration_hint: Share of all commits by the single most active member. Higher means knowledge is concentrated.

dashboard.missing_data_one: {{count}} repository was analyzed before per-commit history was recorded — the charts below under-count until it is refreshed.
dashboard.missing_data_other: {{count}} repositories were analyzed before per-commit history was recorded — the charts below under-count until they are refreshed.
dashboard.timeline_empty: No per-commit history yet — refresh this member's repositories to populate the timeline.
dashboard.large_share_hint: {{pct}}% of commits change more than 500 lines. A high share means changes land as large batches rather than steady increments.
dashboard.heatmap_hint: Commits by weekday and hour, on the author's local clock.
dashboard.shares_hint: This member's share of each repository's full commit history.

compare.title: Compare members
compare.pick_two: Pick at least two members to compare.

merge.title: Merge identities
merge.description: One person often commits under several emails. Merging folds every selected identity's commits, churn, and repos into the primary one — everywhere on this page. Reversible: remove a rule below to split that email out again.
merge.empty: No identity merges yet. Select two or more members and pick Merge.

exclusions.title: Member exclusions
exclusions.description: Hide bots or people who've asked not to be measured. A pattern matches a member's email or name (e.g. an exact address, or a glob). Untracked members appear here too — remove their entry to track them again.
exclusions.empty: No custom exclusions. Built-in bot filters still apply.
